basic_info.description: Experience refined living at Park 532! This thoughtfully upgraded 1-bedroom, 2-bathroom home features an additional flex room with a closet, perfect for a home office or guest space. Enjoy the warmth of hardwood floors throughout and soak in bright south-facing views with peek-a-boo glimpses of Twin Peaks, Sutro Tower, and the Bay. The galley-style open kitchen is equipped with premium built-in Gaggenau appliances, including a five-burner gas cooktop, oven, refrigerator, and dishwasher. With beautifully integrated wood paneling and abundant cabinet and counter space, the kitchen is as functional as it is stylish. A dedicated parking space adds convenience to this chic urban retreat. Residents of One Mission Bay enjoy an unparalleled array of amenities: 24-hour lobby staff, an outdoor heated pool, hot tub, resident dining and lounge areas, a sprawling terrace with a fire pit, cabanas, barbecues, and outdoor dining options. Additional highlights include a state-of-the-art fitness center, a business center with private meeting rooms, a library, and a reservable guest suite for visitors. Welcome home to vibrant Mission Bay, surrounded by abundant greenery, and endless activities, it's the perfect place to enjoy urban convenience and outdoor serenity.
